channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: What Israeli and Lebanese officials are saying before Washington talks
item.description: Iran has made a ceasefire in Lebanon a key condition in its ongoing negotiations with the US.

item.title: Iran says technical talks with US in Switzerland conclude successfully
item.description: Iran's top negotiator Mohammad Ghalibaf also says an agreement reached with the US to release $12bn in frozen assets.

item.title: Iran war day 116: US eases Iran sanctions; Lebanon ceasefire holds
item.description: US eases oil sanctions for 60 days after Iran agrees to allow international nuclear inspections.

item.title: Why Iran’s President Pezeshkian is heading to Pakistan after US talks
item.description: This is Pezeshkian's first overseas trip since Iran war began, and comes a day after the high-stakes Switzerland talks.

item.title: Palestine weekly wrap: Israel’s ‘quiet annexation’ grows louder
item.description: Al Jazeera cameraman killed in Gaza, West Bank mosques torched, as Israeli officials describe attempt to expand control.

item.title: Bullying investigated after rare Philippines school shooting kills three
item.description: Three students are killed and seven others wounded after a rare school shooting in the central Philippines.

item.title: Iran says no new commitments on nuclear sites after Vance says inspectors to be invited back
item.description: Iran's foreign ministry says it made "no new commitments" on nuclear inspections after talks in Switzerland.

item.title: Montreal shooting leaves officer, civilian and suspect dead
item.description: It was the first time in 24 years that a Montreal police officer was killed in the line of duty, the city's police chief said.

item.title: Myanmar army killed over 700 civilians in six months, UN says
item.description: The new UN report says the 702 civilian deaths over six months last year included 153 children.

item.title: Tesla crash that killed a woman under US federal investigation
item.description: A Tesla driver on Friday said he was using ‘self-driving’ technology after his vehicle sped into a Texas home.
